description: This Dart source file defines the TaskRepository class, which provides methods to interact with task data stored in a Firestore database. It includes methods for watching all tasks, creating new tasks, updating existing tasks, and deleting tasks, all scoped to a user ID.

classes.name: TaskRepository
classes.description: Repository class providing CRUD and watch operations for Task objects stored in Firestore, scoped per user.

methods.name: watchAll
methods.description: Returns a stream of task lists, updating in real-time for a given user ID.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new task in Firestore under the specified user ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing task in Firestore identified by its ID.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a task from Firestore by its ID for the specified user.
